payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean. All deterministic checks pass: (1) Archive MD5 (a8b06965200029087d5bd730944a56c1) matches the verified hash; (2) loaded split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) exactly match official split sizes; (3) n_channels=3 (RGB) and n_classes=9 are consistent with the 9-label PathMNIST schema under the standard 28×28 RGB MedMNIST distribution; (4) subsampled=false confirms full-dataset usage; (5) no omitted artifacts; (6) deterministic_findings is empty. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K images from a different clinical center) is a known PathMNIST characteristic and is properly documented for downstream OOD evaluation; it does not constitute an ingestion defect. Minor observation: llm_model_digest is null for the qwen3.8 Ollama model, which limits full traceability of the LLM component, but this does not affect the core ML pipeline integrity. No blocking issues identified; proceed to the next stage.
